correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustive. Every one of the 4^8 ordered binary four-state transition pairs is evaluated by exact reachable-subset DFA minimization. An independent table-filling distinguishability engine agrees on maximality for every pair. Every maximal pair has exactly one four-cycle letter and one rank-three letter. With the cycle fixed, all 144 rank-three maps are checked, yielding exactly 128 maximal maps and 16 exceptions, and those exceptions are exactly the maps for which both the kernel pair and the omitted/double-image pair are antipodal. Canonicalization under all 24 state relabelings and the letter swap yields 32 classes of orbit size 48.

value.rationale: The direct source explicitly identifies the lack of a necessary-and-sufficient criterion as the next structural problem and uses a four-state maximizer to demonstrate the failure of its sufficient criteria. The complete n=4 classification is therefore the natural first unresolved slice: it explains exactly why the published exceptional example is maximal, identifies all 16 normalized failures by a simple antipodality obstruction, and gives the complete equality layer rather than an arbitrary isolated computation.
